value.rationale: A complete explicit unique stiffness allocation for every finite free mass-spring chain with arbitrary heterogenous positive masses is a motivated physical spectral design classification. It shows which bonds must carry the stiffness budget relative to the weighted mass center and provides the exact static compliance cost of the dynamics-optimal equal-mass profile; the latter diverges relative to statically optimum by a logarithmic factor. Limitations and close graph-optimization antecedents are disclosed.
